sectors.trend: Positive. WA exploration activity accelerating with Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE targets, Jupiter/Critica rare earths carbonate, and Augustus gold drilling. Commodity prices mixed as oil retreats but base metals supported by China re-rating.
sectors.implications: Exploration names (JUP.AX, CRX.AX, AUG.AX) offer speculative upside. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from China-as-safe-haven narrative. Rare earths theme gaining policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Constructive. Big four banks advance as bond yields ease and rate-hike fears moderate. However, state governments face soaring interest costs, and Bathla insolvency creates credit overhang.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from lower funding costs. Monitor NPL exposure from insolvency wave. Superannuation reform debate (headline 74) could reshape fund flows.

sectors.trend: Volatile. Petrol price shock and east-coast port supply crunch create near-term cost pressure, but crude retreats as Middle East supply fears ease. Coal policy uncertainty (Albo government) weighs on energy transition names.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDS.AX face margin pressure from fuel supply crunch. Oil retreat supports downstream refiners. Coal policy risk creates volatility for energy transition plays.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-negative. Coles (WES.AX) keeps milk prices elevated post-farmer support removal. Fashion brands Cue and Veronika Maine face collapse. Qantas strike risk disrupts freight. Real wage growth crushed by exploited workers.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face input-cost and consumer-sentiment headwinds. QAN.AX strike risk is a near-term catalyst. Defensive consumer staples preferred.

sectors.trend: Positive. Anthropic's $31bn QLD datacentre deal signals major capex cycle. AI adoption themes (headlines 29, 37) gaining traction. US tech names (APTV, ESTC, ASML) show mixed signals.
sectors.implications: Australian datacentre and infrastructure names benefit. CSL.AX and healthcare tech remain defensive anchors. Monitor AI capex cycle sustainability.

sectors.trend: Stressed. Housing 'absurdly unaffordable' (headline 8). ACCC targeting real estate agency monopoly. Tenants see modest relief. Trump policy mulls crashing house prices via immigration/monetary channels.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Residential construction names under pressure. ACCC action could reshape agency fee structures.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely to grind higher on bank strength and easing yields, but petrol price shock, Qantas strike risk, and AUD weakness cap upside. Expect 1–2% range-bound trading with sector rotation into materials and financials. Fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports is a near-term CPI wildcard.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if RBA holds or cuts and China demand sustains commodity prices. Anthropic datacentre cycle and WA resources pipeline provide structural growth vectors. Key risk: IMF-mandated fiscal tightening combined with a rate hike could compress valuations across growth and REIT sectors. Superannuation reform debate may reshape fund flows.
